podcast.title: Pioneered by Caca de Lux
podcast.body: Caca de Lux was described as a pioneer of glam punk in Spanish, combining punk's rebellious energy with a more flamboyant and theatrical aesthetic. This made them a fundamental pillar of the Movida Madrileña. "una banda pionera del punk más glam en español y pilar fundamental de la nación de movida madrileña."
